title_cyr: Бог да га убие бабо тој ваше село
title_latin: Bog da ga ubie babo toj vaše selo
title_en: May God strike down, father, that village of yours
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Mixed Serbian-style dialect (куде су ти, твоје, на руку). Guesses: 'буѓава' (scabby/mangy), 'жуљави уста' (sore mouth), 'калешо' (unknown, maybe 'invited/chosen one'), 'приварде' (see to the horse). Origin unclear.

lines.cyr: Бог да га убие бабо тој ваше село,
lines.lat: Bog da ga ubie babo toj vaše selo,
lines.en: May God strike him down, father, that village of yours,

lines.cyr: кој га насели бабо меѓу два рида.
lines.lat: koj ga naseli babo meǵu dva rida.
lines.en: whoever settled it, father, between two hills.

lines.cyr: Меѓу два рида, бабо, меѓу две реке.
lines.lat: Meǵu dva rida, babo, meǵu dve reke.
lines.en: Between two hills, father, between two rivers.

lines.cyr: Ти ли се најде бабо мене да ме сретнеш,
lines.lat: Ti li se najde babo mene da me sretneš,
lines.en: Was it you, father, who found me to meet me,

lines.cyr: мене да ме сретнеш бабо са жуљави уста.
lines.lat: mene da me sretneš babo sa žuljavi usta.
lines.en: to meet me, father, with sore mouth.

lines.cyr: Жуљави уста, бабо, с' криви колена,
lines.lat: Žuljavi usta, babo, s' krivi kolena,
lines.en: Sore mouth, father, with crooked knees,

lines.cyr: с' криви колена, бабо, с' буѓава глава,
lines.lat: s' krivi kolena, babo, s' buǵava glava,
lines.en: with crooked knees, father, with a scabby(?) head,

lines.cyr: с' буѓава глава бабо, с'с грбаве плеќе.
lines.lat: s' buǵava glava babo, s's grbave pleḱe.
lines.en: with a scabby(?) head, father, with a hunched back.

lines.cyr: Куде су ти бабо мори твоје четири ќерке,
lines.lat: Kude su ti babo mori tvoje četiri ḱerke,
lines.en: Where are, father, hey, your four daughters,

lines.cyr: твоје четири ќерке, бабо, Гина и Стамена,
lines.lat: tvoje četiri ḱerke, babo, Gina i Stamena,
lines.en: your four daughters, father, Gina and Stamena,

lines.cyr: Гина и Стамена, бабо, кара, ах Елена
lines.lat: Gina i Stamena, babo, kara, ah Elena
lines.en: Gina and Stamena, father, dark, ah, Elena,

lines.cyr: Првата бабо мори мене да ме сретне,
lines.lat: Prvata babo mori mene da me sretne,
lines.en: The first, father, hey, to meet me,

lines.cyr: другата бабо мори, коња да приварде,
lines.lat: drugata babo mori, konja da privarde,
lines.en: the second, father, hey, to see to the horse,

lines.cyr: треќата, бабо мори, вечеру да прави,
lines.lat: treḱata, babo mori, večeru da pravi,
lines.en: the third, father, hey, to make supper,

lines.cyr: четвртата, бабо мори, на руку да ме преспие!
lines.lat: četvrtata, babo mori, na ruku da me prespie!
lines.en: the fourth, father, hey, to put me to sleep on her arm!
